notes: Paths are relative to the stated root. The Unity project is nested one level down, so code paths begin with 'Lexomancy/Assets/...' and the design vault (its own git repo) with 'design/...'. If the retrieval arm reports paths relative to the inner Unity project instead, strip the leading 'Lexomancy/' segment.

queries.query: when an attack has nobody picked out to receive it, how does the game decide which opponent it lands on, and is that decision repeatable across replays?
queries.why: The static ladder that picks a single-target recipient with no RNG: secure the kill, else biggest effective bite, else lowest HP fraction, else lane order.

queries.query: how do gameplay extension pieces get discovered and installed at startup without anyone maintaining a hand-written registration list?
queries.why: KernelBootstrap walks AppDomain assemblies, filters types carrying a marker attribute, Activator-creates each and calls Install against the builder.

queries.query: how does one system tell another that a run just began or that the player's health moved, without either side holding a reference to the other?
queries.why: A static hub of C# Action delegates plus type-safe Raise* publishers, explicitly documented as decoupling modules from singleton instances.

queries.query: what makes the tiles you're holding spread into a curve and lift up when the pointer moves over one of them?
queries.why: MonoBehaviour with serialized spacing/elevation/scale fields, an AnimationCurve for adjacent displacement, and a coroutine that animates toward target positions on hover and selection.

queries.query: why are some saved collections kept as plain ordered lists when the data is really a set of unique identifiers?
queries.why: Comments on visitedNodes, ownedAxiomIds and axiomInscriptions each state the collection is a List rather than a HashSet/Dictionary specifically because Unity serialization cannot round-trip those.

queries.query: what stops a neural-network encode from blocking a frame when the player clicks something, and where does it fail loudly instead of degrading?
queries.why: A depth-counted opt-in scope whose AssertAllowed throws InvalidOperationException during play mode outside an explicit Allow(...) using-block.

queries.query: how is a struct message handed to every interested listener in a fixed before / modify / after ordering, with the listeners stored per message type?
queries.why: Generic Subscribe/Dispatch constrained to `where T : struct, IGameEvent`, handler lists boxed in a Dictionary<Type, object>, dispatched Pre/Modify/Post with a LINQ Where+OrderBy on priority.

queries.query: what's the shared authored-asset base class every menu ability derives from, with a resource price and a hook for the ones that need extra player input first?
queries.why: Both are abstract ScriptableObject bases with a cost field, CanExecute/Execute, and virtual RequiresAdditionalInput + OnEnter/OnExitPerformActionState hooks; ConsumableDefinition's docs say it mirrors PlayerActionSO.

queries.query: how does the game keep dealing out characters without ever running dry of vowels, while still making the uncommon ones feel scarce?
queries.why: A weighted cumulative random draw over a per-character count dictionary that auto-adds a fresh virtual set once the pool falls under a threshold fraction of its initial size.

queries.query: how does a single word get sorted into the closest thematic category using vector distance, and where do the runner-up categories come from?
queries.why: Embeds the word, scores it against every category centroid via IEmbeddingService.Similarity, sorts descending, takes the top as primary and collects secondaries above a configured floor.

queries.query: there are two lanes for background inference requests — one where only the newest submission still matters and one where every callback is guaranteed to fire in order. where is that implemented?
queries.why: Class doc names exactly three channels — a superseding single pending slot, a guaranteed-delivery FIFO queue, and a batch channel riding the same queue — with one in-flight request at a time.

queries.query: which component paints the six-sided grid into Unity's tile renderer and keeps cells the player hasn't uncovered hidden?
queries.why: MonoBehaviour holding a Tilemap reference plus TileBase assets for hidden/available/occupied/door/portal states, subscribing to tile-state-change events in Start and unsubscribing in OnDestroy.

queries.query: is the logic for holding, selecting and hovering the player's items written twice for the two modes, or shared behind a type parameter?
queries.why: A pure-C# `GenericHandController<T> where T : IHandItem` with Action<T> events; the companion doc states the same system serves letter tiles and word cards.

queries.query: how does a loot table roll its rewards, and how are duplicate gold or currency drops consolidated before they reach the player?
queries.why: LootTableSO.Roll seeds an RNG from the run, rolls each group, then ConsolidateCurrencies/RemoveDuplicateItems; LootApplicator switches on reward type to mutate RunState.

queries.query: how is the word dictionary loaded from the text asset and how does word validation look a word up?
queries.why: Awake splits a TextAsset into a HashSet<string> of trimmed lowercase words; Lookup does the case-insensitive Contains check with a disableValidation bypass.

queries.query: how does the inventory keep stacks of consumable items and make them persist between rooms but reset on a new run?
queries.why: Serializable ConsumableStack plus a DontDestroyOnLoad singleton MonoBehaviour with InitializeForNewRun clearing and re-seeding starting items.

queries.query: what does the wordplay turn manager do with the input action map, and how does it track the current turn state?
queries.why: Singleton MonoBehaviour that constructs PlayerInput in Awake, enables the WordGame map and binds SubmitTurn/CancelTurn in OnEnable, unbinds in OnDisable, and exposes IGameState + OnStateChanged.

queries.query: how are pending telegraphed actions scheduled and then taken when they come due on the battle tick timeline?
queries.why: Post appends to an active list; TakeDue(tick) removes and returns every action whose absolute ResolveAtTick matches; RemoveActive cancels one early.

queries.query: where are hex neighbors and the direction between two hex coordinates computed?
queries.why: Static GetNeighbors iterating the six HexDirection values and GetDirectionBetween resolving axis-collinear q/r/s differences.

queries.query: where is TargetHeuristic.ChooseTarget implemented?
queries.why: Exact definition site of the static ChooseTarget method.

queries.query: where is the EffectManager class defined and what events does it expose?
queries.why: Class declaration with OnEffectAdded/Removed/Ticked/Expired/Countered events and AddEffect/RemoveEffect.

queries.query: find the SimpleHeuristicSelector implementation of IAbilitySelector
queries.why: SimpleHeuristicSelector : IAbilitySelector with the heal-threshold / expected-damage / first-ready selection ladder.

queries.query: where is BertTokenizer and its WordPiece tokenization method?
queries.why: Class at line 13; BasicTokenize at 83 and WordPieceTokenize at 119, feeding Tokenize's input_ids/attention_mask output.

queries.query: where is the AxiomHost class implemented?
queries.why: Sealed class owning the run's acquired axiom set and projecting them onto the scoring registrations and the capability AxiomEngine.

queries.query: design document covering axioms and the forging flow — what's decided versus still leaning?
queries.why: Front-matter marks design_status: leaning with decision_refs D-0002..D-0009, and the body states P-1..P-5 were accepted as ledger entries while the library stays working-level.

queries.query: what is supposed to happen when a player types gibberish — does the game refuse the input or still produce something playable?
queries.why: States the fallback guarantee 'every input produces a valid Battle Card', with no error message, deterministic output, and a tone-to-generic-pattern table.

queries.query: how do the global managers come into existence when you press play on a single scene instead of starting from the front end?
queries.why: The doc describes the lazy-initialization GlobalManagers prefab with DontDestroyOnLoad singletons; GameBootstrapper.Awake instantiates that prefab only when GameController.Instance is null, then destroys itself.

queries.query: notes on how a placed word is checked for validity and whether it stays connected to the rest of the board
queries.why: The markdown describes dictionary lookup plus the adjacency/connectedness check and the leaf-node pickup rule; ThreadingRuleEvaluator is the pure rule class implementing valid-placement discovery over tile and thread snapshots.

queries.query: trace changing one held letter into a different letter: the action asset, the picker that pops up, and where the discarded letter goes
queries.why: The SO returns RequiresAdditionalInput true and opens the modal via EnsureInScene, subscribing OnLetterSelected; its callback at line 139 calls HandManager.LetterBag.ReturnLetter(oldLetter), which increments the bag count.

queries.query: the arithmetic that turns a hit into lost hit points, and the separate projection of that same arithmetic used when the game picks who to swing at
queries.why: ResolveDamage does base + attacker Attack - defender Defense floored at zero then modifier channels; BattleUnit.TakeDamage drains Block once before HP; TargetHeuristic.ProjectedHpLoss deliberately mirrors both minus the modifier channels.
